skill2: Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects all enemies.
Attract: Taunt all enemies for 15.09 sec.

caveats: ⚑ skill1's enemy DEF ▼ 8.4% is TEAM-WIDE damage-relevant but has NO schema channel: StatKey defPct means the holder's own DEF, and the sim's boss DEF is an engine-level constant, not a buffable stat. It is therefore UNMODELED and the sim under-credits every ally's damage while it is up. Encoding it as damageTakenPct would be a fabricated conversion (DEF ▼ 8.4% ≠ Damage Taken ▲ 8.4%) and is refused.

⚑ Uptime arithmetic for that debuff (contingent on the datamined cadence): 120 ammo at SMG ~20 rounds/s effective = ~6.0s firing + 187 reload frames ≈ 3.1s = a ~9.1s magazine cycle against a 10s debuff, so the last-bullet debuff is effectively PERMANENT after the first magazine rather than intermittent.
skill1's enemy ATK ▼ 8.4% is defensive-only at scope lock (boss damage is unmodeled, allies are immortal) — no damage channel exists for it.

skill2's Attract/Taunt and the self Damage Taken ▼ 57.86% are both defensive-only at scope lock; the schema's damageTakenPct is a BOSS debuff (positive = boss takes more), not a self mitigation stat, so neither line maps to it.

⚑ The burst's 163.1% hit is authored noFb:true per the burst-cast FB-exemption rule (a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens); crit-eligibility is kit-silent and left to the engine default (no crit flag set).
The burst's 'Affects 10 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK' selector collapses to the single boss at scope lock; authored as target enemy.
The burst's ally DEF ▲ 12.93% is authored for kit completeness only — defPct is offensively inert in v1.
The burst's 'above 50% HP' activation gate is always satisfied at scope lock (no HP pool, nobody takes damage), so no block gate is authored; the verbatim line is recorded in unmodeled.burst.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Ludmilla (SMG/Water/Defender/Burst I) is a near-pure defensive kit: the only damage this override models is her burst's 163.1%-of-final-ATK instant hit, plus an ally DEF ▲ 12.93% / 10s carried for kit completeness (defPct is inert in v1). Both burst lines are keyed to burstCast (her own cast), and the burst hit is FB-exempt because a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens. Skill1 and skill2 are modeled as EMPTY: skill1's last-bullet enemy ATK ▼ is defensive, and its enemy DEF ▼ 8.4% — genuinely team-wide damage-relevant, at near-permanent uptime — has no schema channel because boss DEF is an engine constant rather than a buffable stat; skill2's Taunt and self Damage Taken ▼ 57.86% have no damage channel at scope lock. Those skipped lines are recorded verbatim in unmodeled and the DEF ▼ gap is flagged, not approximated.

flags.estimate: Near-100% uptime after the first magazine; effect on team damage is whatever a 8.4% boss-DEF reduction is worth in the formula's (ATK·k − DEF) term — low single-digit % team-wide at scope-lock ATK, larger for low-ATK units.
flags.reasoning: The kit line reduces the BOSS's DEF, which lifts every ally's damage. No StatKey targets enemy DEF (defPct is the holder's own DEF, documented inert; damageTakenPct is a different multiplier and using it would be a fabricated conversion), and the engine's boss DEF is a fixed constant. Uptime whole-picture check: 120 ammo ÷ ~20 rounds/s ≈ 6.0s firing + 187 reload frames ≈ 3.1s ⇒ ~9.1s per last-bullet cycle vs a 10s window, so it re-arms before it lapses.
flags.recipe: A/B the sim with the boss-DEF constant scaled by (1 − 0.084 × uptime) and read the per-unit delta; confirm empirically by comparing a teammate's popup values in a recorded fight before her first reload vs after (same buff state, same range band) — the ratio is the DEF-term lift.

flags.reasoning: Authoring convention, not a measurement for this unit: a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens, so the +50% FB major should not apply to the 163.1% hit. She is Burst I, so her cast is furthest in time from FB entry — the exemption is least likely to be wrong here.
flags.recipe: Focus recording of her burst: read the 163.1% popup value and divide by the same-frame expected final ATK·1.631; a ×1.5 residual means the hit did take the FB major and noFb must be dropped.

flags.estimate: left to the engine default (no crit flag authored)
flags.reasoning: The kit text is silent on crit for the burst hit. Setting crit:true would credit an unmeasured crit expectation on the unit's only damage line; leaving it unset keeps the engine's flat-damage default in charge.
flags.recipe: Popup colour read on a focus recording of her burst across ≥10 casts — orange/crit-icon popups mean the hit is crit-eligible and crit:true should be authored.

flags.field: burst[1] — 'above 50% HP' gate treated as always-true
flags.reasoning: Scope lock has no HP pool and the boss deals no modeled damage, so an HP-threshold gate can never fail. Authoring a gate primitive for it would add a condition the sim cannot evaluate.
flags.recipe: None needed at scope lock; revisit if/when boss damage and an HP pool are modeled (then the gate becomes a real duty cycle).

flags.field: base cadence tuple (SMG pulls/s, ammo 120, reloadFrames 187)
flags.estimate: ~20 effective rounds/s (60 ÷ ceil(60 ÷ nominal)); ~6.0s magazine + ~3.1s reload
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: datamined rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are unreliable, and the effective rate must snap to 60fps frame boundaries. This tuple is what sets her last-bullet frequency, which is the entire uptime argument for the unmodeled DEF ▼ above — so a wrong cadence changes whether that debuff is permanent or intermittent.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read from a focus recording: count frames between full magazine and dry, and frames from dry to refill, for ≥3 cycles.
